DISPOSITION RECORDED (per coordinator direction) — do not re-litigate:

**Option (b), un-gating the OIDC credential step to all arms: REJECTED.** It hands AWS credentials to arms holding third-party API keys (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / OPENAI_API_KEY), widening the blast radius of the scoped Bedrock CI role, for zero coverage gain — the same model called from three arms teaches the same fact three times. The OIDC step stays gated `if: matrix.provider == 'bedrock'`.

**Also rejected: un-pinning _MODEL** so the eval follows each arm. The pin exists to hold the model fixed while reproducing bug 0707; unpinning converts a single-model regression reproduction into a 3x-spend cross-provider eval — a different test with a different purpose.

**Implemented: option (a), the provider-aware readiness sentinel.** Test-harness correctness only; zero credential-surface change.

Implementation notes:
- `tests/external/_live_llm.py`: `live_llm_ready()` gains an optional `required_provider`. When supplied, readiness requires the arm's `configured_provider()` to MATCH it as well as that provider's credential being present. New `skip_unless_provider(provider)` mark factory. Purely additive — the no-arg call and the module-level `skip_without_live_llm` are untouched, so the seven modules that follow the arm keep their exact behaviour.
- `tests/external/test_completion_banking_behavior_0707.py`: derives `_PINNED_PROVIDER` from `_MODEL` itself (so the pin and the gate cannot drift) and applies the pinned gate to both tests.
- Rendered skip on a mismatched arm: `no live LLM: this module pins a 'bedrock' model, but the configured arm resolves 'openai' — that arm cannot cover it, so it runs on the 'bedrock' arm instead`. Visible, not silent.
- Canary-safe: the all-skip canary fires only when collected>=1 and executed==0; the arm-following modules still execute on non-bedrock arms.

Incidental finding while building the structural guard: a naive substring scan for a pinned `<provider>:` model flags `test_pydantic_ai_cutover_live.py`, which merely DISCUSSES `anthropic:claude-opus-4-8` in its module docstring. The guard was tightened to match assignments only, so prose does not read as a pin. That module pins nothing and is unchanged.
